title: lathyrus pratensis f. sepium
intro: Lathyrus pratensis f. sepium, commonly known as Meadow Pea, is a subspecies of pea plant that belongs to the Fabaceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help manage blood sugar levels and improve cardiovascular health. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus pratensis f. sepium may also include vasodilatory effects, which can help to lower blood pressure and improve circulation.
